mapper.update: UPDATE users SET user_email = #{userEmail}, user_login_id = #{userLoginId}, user_pass_hash = #{userPass}, user_icon = #{userIcon}, user_nickname = #{userNickname} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, user_email AS userEmail, user_login_id AS userLoginId, user_pass_hash AS userPassHash FROM users WHERE user_email = #{loginValue} OR user_login_id = #{loginValue}

SELECT user_id AS userId, user_icon AS userIcon, user_nickname AS userNickname, user_email AS userEmail, user_login_id AS userLoginId, user_pass_hash AS userPassHash FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( user_id, user_login_id, friend_code, user_email, user_pass_hash, user_nickname, user_icon ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userLoginId}, #{friendCode}, #{userEmail}, #{userPassHash}, #{userNickname}, #{userIcon} )
